title: Analyze an absorbing Markov chain
description: You separate transient states from absorbing states and compute eventual outcomes.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You define Start, Middle, AbsorbA, and AbsorbB. The final two states transition to themselves with probability one, making them absorbing states.
You identify transient indices [0,1] and absorbing indices [2,3]. Q contains transient-to-transient transitions, while R contains transient-to-absorbing transitions.

steps.question: Which expression produces probabilities for the eventual absorbing destinations?
steps.answer: B=N@R produces those probabilities. The row sums of N instead give expected steps to absorption.

steps.description: You print expected step counts from Start and Middle. The recorded B rows both sum to one and give each starting state's probabilities of AbsorbA and AbsorbB.
